description: Figure 7 is a stacked horizontal bar chart illustrating the average rate at which the model attends most to each input segment—context, generated response, or other (e.g., system prompts)—during generation. The chart contains two horizontal bars, one labeled “Ours” and the other “Standard,” each divided into three colored segments. For the “Ours” bar, the segments are: blue (Context) at 60.6%, orange (Generated Response) at 31.7%, and green (Other) at 7.7%. For the “Standard” bar, the segments are: blue (Context) at 23.6%, orange (Generated Response) at 51.1%, and green (Other) at 25.3%. A legend below the chart identifies the color coding: blue for Context, orange for Generated Response, and green for Other. The chart visually contrasts how the “Ours” model allocates more attention to context compared to the “Standard” model, which focuses more on the generated response and other segments.
